text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Dufferin Street, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install traffic control signals at the intersection of Dufferin Street and Florence Street. The traffic control signals will replace the existing pedestrian crossover on Dufferin Street, south of Florence Street, and provide enhanced safety for all road users, particularly pedestrians and cyclists, and is justified based on the assessment undertaken.

City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Dufferin Street and Florence Street. 2. In conjunction with the installation of traffic control signals at Dufferin Street and Florence Street, City Council authorize removal of the pedestrian crossover on Dufferin Street, immediately south of Florence Street.
